function.arguments: {"analyst":"Round-2 analysis of avGFP brightness: O1 (3.90) and O6 (3.56) show conservative surface charge edits plus mild repacking stay bright, while O4 (1.30) and O5 (1.30) collapse with buried polar swaps.","hypothesis":"Brightness is set by edit chemistry, not edit count: variants whose edits are surface charge swaps or conservative repacking will stay above the O4 collapse level (~1.30), whereas added buried polar substitutions will not.","evidence_ids":["O1","O4","O6"],"designs":["C02 T97I:D117G:K166R","C03 P89L:I171N","C01 G116S:V150D:L194P","NEW V93I:L221Q:K166R","NEW K156E:K214E:K166R","NEW I128N:D197V:K26R"],"target_reference":"O4","target_design":1,"design_reasons":["O4 C02 keeps only surface/loop chemistry (T97I, D117G, K166R), so it should stay far above the 1.30 collapse level.","O1 C03 is a minimal two-edit repack like the bright O1 class, testing whether small edits suffice.","O4 C01 adds a buried L194P to a surface pair, probing whether that single proline is enough to erode brightness.","O1 adds the conservative surface K166R to the brightest observed pair to test additivity of surface charge edits.","O2 tests whether a third surface charge swap on the K156E:K214E background preserves its 3.86-level brightness.","O3 adds K26R to the I128N:D197V pair to test whether rescuing surface charge offsets the polar I128N."],"feedback_adjustment":"Round-1 feedback (O6, measured 3.562 vs 3.077 predicted, residual +0.49) supported the chemistry-over-count model, so I keep nominating surface-charge/conservative-edit designs and stop proposing buried polar multi-edit variants; if C02 scores below O4 here, I will drop the surface-charge premise and re-center on O1-like minimal repacks."}

function.arguments: {"analyst":"Round-2 batch: bright-regime backbones with conservative surface charge edits vs. a special-class L194P probe.","hypothesis":"Brightness tracks edit chemistry, not edit count: layering conservative surface charge swaps (K166R/K26R/N159D) onto the bright O1-O3 backbones will stay well above the O4 low-brightness level, while the special-class L194P design (C01) will not exceed that same reference.","evidence_ids":["O4","O6","O1"],"designs":["C01 G116S:V150D:L194P","C03 P89L:I171N","NEW K156E:K214E:K166R","NEW V93I:L221Q:K166R","NEW K26R:N159D:K166R","NEW I128N:D197V:S175T"],"target_reference":"O4","target_design":2,"design_reasons":["O4 multi-edit with buried polar swaps measured 1.30; C01 adds special-class L194P as a low-side control probe.","O4 sets the low floor at 1.30; C03 is two nonpolar/repacking edits, predicted to exceed that floor.","O4 combines a buried polar swap with charge change and collapsed; this keeps O2's charge pair and adds only a conservative K166R.","O1 is the brightest observation at 3.90; adding conservative K166R tests whether that level tolerates a surface charge swap.","O4 shows charge-plus-polar edits can collapse; this pairs two surface charge swaps with K166R only, no polar insertion.","O3 is bright at 3.85; adding polar S175T tests whether a single surface polar edit preserves that level."],"feedback_adjustment":"Prior forecast for D21N:K101R:I123V was confirmed (measured 3.562 vs predicted 3.077, residual +0.485), so I keep the O4 floor as the pass bar and demote the L194P-containing C01 out of primary position in favor of the charge-edit design C03."}
